You don't need to decide on the spot; note down the information, compare cash flows and shortlist 2 – 3 units you like. The November 15 Sun Saphia Residence introduction event focuses on overall information: the developer's brand, location, scale, design, amenities and expected legal status. The official price list, payment policy and specific available units are usually only announced at the sales event (expected December 5, 2026). So the November 15 session is the right time to ask questions, view floor plans and narrow down unit types; the decision on which unit to choose is best left until the official price list and policy are out.
